nativeConfirmationPhases: click to native confirmation entry/first observed visible prompt
native confirmation return to transaction complete/durable readback/DOM/images/frame
performance.confirmationTimingMethod: Original native window.confirm is delegated unchanged. Browser performance clock records entry and return; actual dialog event records first observed visibility using the same-host epoch clock. Both opening and returned-confirmation-to-durable/DOM/images/frame phases must be <=1000ms. Human confirmation wait is excluded only from returned-confirmation phase, with original total click duration and full original dialog kept.
